Name: Spenny the Reality Warper
Author: spacechase0
Description:
It's been a while since Spenny has appeared. She was simply biding her time, building up her power until she became unstoppable.

The world may not revolve around you, but it sure does revolve around (S)Penny.

Introducing: Penny the Reality Warper

Children are immune, because Penny loves children [s]and totally not because I couldn't figure out why that didn't work[/s].

[youtube]FhufSkuFNi4[/youtube]

Be mindful of the glitches in reality from such powerful warping.

Make sure to install the rest of the series for the full experience:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2755]Spenny[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14249]Spenny Lite[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14984]Spenny Deluxe[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17326]Spennying Wheel[/url]
[/list]
[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.

[/list]
[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.
